infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: SkelClock records where you are when you clock on and off, so your hours can be matched to the right job.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: If you turn on auto-detect arrival, SkelClock checks your location in the background to suggest a clock-in when you reach a job site. This is off by default, you can turn it off anytime, and every automatic suggestion needs your confirmation before it counts as a real clock event.
